name: Two-colour pairs
description: Two cards for each of the ten colour pairs, showing what each pair does best. Every card has both colours in its cost.

cards.name: Cloudwatch Magistrate
cards.rule_text:
Flying
Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, tap target creature an opponent controls. It doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.

cards.name: Banners Over the Bay
cards.rule_text:
Creatures you control with flying get +1/+1.
At the beginning of your end step, if you control three or more creatures with flying, draw a card.

cards.name: Silt-Mind Infiltrator
cards.rule_text:
Menace
Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, that player mills three cards and you draw a card.

cards.name: Stolen Remembrance
cards.rule_text: Each opponent mills five cards. Then put a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
cards.flavor_text: Their past is now your army.

cards.name: Pyre-Dance Reveller
cards.rule_text:
Menace
Whenever another creature you control dies, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.

cards.name: Bonfire Bargain
cards.rule_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or pay 3 life.
CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. Draw a card.

cards.name: Stormhide Brute
cards.rule_text:
Trample, haste
When CARDNAME enters, it fights up to one target creature you don't control.
cards.flavor_text: It does not wait for an invitation.

cards.name: Thunderdrum Shaman
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {R} or {G}.
Creatures you control with power 4 or greater have haste.

cards.name: Hearthgrove Marshal
cards.rule_text:
Vigilance
Other creatures you control get +1/+1.
Whenever another creature you control enters, you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Rally the Meadow Folk
cards.rule_text: Create X 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens. Then put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.

cards.name: Tithe Collector of the Pale Spire
cards.rule_text:
Lifelink
Whenever you gain life for the first time each turn, each opponent loses 2 life.

cards.name: Out of the Quiet Earth
cards.rule_text: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. You gain life equal to its toughness.

cards.name: Stormglass Adept
cards.rule_text:
Prowess
Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, draw a card, then discard a card.

cards.name: Mirrored Thunder
cards.rule_text: Copy target instant or sorcery spell you control twice. You may choose new targets for the copies.
cards.flavor_text: Once is a spell. Three times is a storm.

cards.name: Mire-Root Reclaimer
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, mill three cards. Then you may return a creature or land card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Rotcap Colossus
cards.rule_text:
Deathtouch
Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, create two 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens.

cards.name: Vanguard of the Burning Banner
cards.rule_text:
First strike
Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token that's tapped and attacking.

cards.name: Charge of the Dawn Legion
cards.rule_text: Creatures you control get +2/+1 and gain first strike until end of turn.
cards.flavor_text: The sun rose behind them, and so did the cheer.

cards.name: Kelpfield Hydra
cards.rule_text:
Trample
CARDNAME enters with X +1/+1 counters on it.
Whenever you put one or more +1/+1 counters on another creature you control, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.

cards.name: Tidewater Growth
cards.rule_text: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. Draw two cards.
